Stryker and Conformis enter into a development agreement on September 30, 2019, where Conformis develops Patient-Specific Instrumentation to be used with Stryker's Off-The-Shelf Knee Implant, known as the KIB Product. Conformis is responsible for furnishing Stryker with Deliverables as defined in the R&D Work Plan, and Stryker has the opportunity to analyze and test each Deliverable for Acceptance. NCM will provide various services to Theatres, including the Digital Carousel, Pre-Feature Program, Policy Trailer, and Video Display Program, with Theatres participating in these services as specified. Network Affiliate shall provide written notice to NCM of changes to its list of IMAX Screens. **Section 1:**
Exact Sciences Corporation and Pfizer Inc. agree to a promotion agreement where Exact desires to leverage Pfizer's expertise in sales, marketing, and other core capabilities for its product in the United States, and Pfizer desires to provide such expertise and invest in Exact's promotion of the product. The agreement outlines key obligations, including Pfizer's responsibility for product promotion, detailing efforts, and investment, as well as Exact's responsibility for product ownership and marketing. The agreement also specifies financial terms, including a promotion fee and shared expenses.

**Section 2:**
The contract primarily outlines the terms of a marketing agreement between Exact Sciences Corp and Pfizer, with a focus on the promotion of a medical device called "COLOGUARD" for colorectal neoplasia detection. Key obligations include the establishment of a Joint Steering Committee to oversee the implementation of an annual marketing plan, which outlines promotional activities and budget allocations. The agreement also defines various terms, including "Government Official," "Gross Margin," and "Promotion Fee," and specifies the roles and responsibilities of the parties involved.

**Section 3:**
The Joint Steering Committee (JSC) oversees the Joint Operations Committee (JOC) and Joint Review Committee (JRC), ensuring compliance with the Annual Marketing Plan and Applicable Laws. The JSC, JOC, and JRC make decisions by unanimous agreement, with disputes escalated to the Alliance Managers and Senior Officers for resolution. The JOC prepares the Annual Marketing Plan, reviews Product Marketing strategies, and allocates Baseline M&P Expenses and Shared M&P Expenses. The JRC reviews and approves Promotional Materials, ensuring compliance with Applicable Laws and each Party's Applicable Compliance/Review Policies.

**Section 4:**
Pfizer and Exact Sciences Corp have a licensing agreement where Pfizer shall have no rights to the Product except as expressly authorized under this Agreement, and Exact retains all rights in and relating to the Product, including proprietary and property interests. Exact is responsible for manufacturing, research and development, intellectual property defense, product liability claims, and government investigations related to the Product. The Parties shall collaborate on establishing and maintaining a sufficient number of Sales Representatives to Promote the Product, and Exact shall provide Product Training to Pfizer's Sales Representatives.

**Section 5:**
Exact Sciences Corporation and Pfizer shall collaborate on promotional activities for the Product, with Exact responsible for creating and utilizing approved promotional materials, and Pfizer committing to a minimum of $12 million in Baseline M&P Expense each Calendar Quarter, with a total of $80 million annually, and matching Exact's Shared M&P Expense up to $24 million in 2018, $22 million in 2019, $21 million in 2020, and $20 million in 2021.

**Section 6:**
Exact shall provide a written report to Pfizer each month, detailing Baseline M&P Expenses and Shared M&P Expenses incurred and paid by Exact, with sufficient itemization for Pfizer to confirm these expenses were incurred pursuant to the Annual Marketing Plan. Pfizer shall provide a written report to Exact each month, detailing Shared M&P Expenses incurred and paid by Pfizer. Exact owes Pfizer a service fee equal to 50% of Incremental Laboratory Service Revenue multiplied by Gross Margin Percent, with a minimum Gross Margin Percent of 68% and a maximum of 74%.

**Section 7:**
Each Party represents and warrants to the other that it will comply with all Applicable Laws, including those related to healthcare, trade, and ethics, and will maintain a compliance and ethics program to prevent and detect violations of such laws.

**Section 8:**
Each Party agrees to indemnify the other for Claims arising out of their respective obligations, with Exact indemnifying Pfizer for Product-related Claims and Pfizer indemnifying Exact for breach of representations and warranties. Both Parties must maintain commercial general liability insurance with minimum $5 million coverage. Liability is limited except for indemnification obligations, breaches of Section 7, and willful misconduct or gross negligence.

**Section 9:**
The contract outlines the terms of a business agreement between Pfizer and Exact Sciences Corporation, with a focus on advertising services for a product. Key obligations include Exact paying a royalty rate of 2% to Pfizer during the term, and Pfizer providing advertising services with a six-month notice period. The contract also specifies the consequences of termination, including the cessation of commitments and the obligation to pay financial commitments made by Pfizer.

The agreement involves the creation, marketing, and distribution of a cobranded, customized version of the Skype Software in the PRC, featuring the Online Group's and Skype's brand features, and the development and hosting of a co-branded web site or web site content. The parties will share revenue from the customized version of the Skype Software, with the Company responsible for direct expenses, and the parties will indemnify each other against third-party claims.

**Section 2:**
Skype and TOM ONLINE INC agree to co-brand the Skype Software, with Skype designing and producing the Company-Skype Branded Application, and the Company designing, producing, hosting, and maintaining the Company-Skype Branded Web Site. The Parties will mutually agree on promotional activities, customer support, and payment methods, with Skype providing technical support and the Company providing first-level support to customers. The Company will promote the availability of the Company-Skype Branded Application to its customers, and the Parties will comply with applicable laws and regulations of the PRC.

**Section 3:**
The contract grants a limited, non-exclusive license to use, market, and reproduce the Online BVI Intellectual Property and Skype Intellectual Property for the development and transmission of the Company-Skype Branded Application, Branded Content, and Branded Web Site. The license is royalty-free, but subject to provisions, and the parties agree to share 50% of Adjusted Net Revenue.

**Section 4:**
The Company and Online BVI will provide Payment Services directly or through a Subsidiary or Affiliate, and pay Direct Expenses promptly upon invoice. The Parties will furnish Statements within thirty days of each calendar quarter, showing Gross Revenue, Direct Expenses, and Adjusted Net Revenue, and pay 50% of Adjusted Net Revenue within sixty days. Payments will be made in Euros, and if revenue is earned in other currencies, the Party will convert amounts into Euros based on the Wall Street Journal exchange rate.

**Section 5:**
The contract primarily focuses on the non-competition obligations of the parties, particularly during the three-month period following the launch of an enterprise version of the Skype Software. The parties agree to refrain from discussing, negotiating, or entering into any agreements with third parties regarding enterprise co-branded Internet-based applications in simplified Chinese, which are substantially similar in functionality and features as the Enterprise Skype Software. The restrictions do not apply to Skype's existing operations or agreements with customers and affiliates, and the non-competition period may terminate under certain conditions, including the failure to meet specific growth rates in customer numbers.
